homepage.introLine1: Hey, good to have you here.
homepage.introLine2: Take your time and explore a selection of typefaces designed with care by Iñigo Uriarte.

about.paragraph1: Indigo Alphabets® is an independent type foundry led by Iñigo Uriarte and based in Berlin.
about.paragraph2: The project aspires to fill gaps in the typographic panorama, push the field forward and platform the explorative pulse of the designer.
about.paragraph3: Especialized in futuristic, blackletter and bitmap faces, Indigo Alphabets is commited to the highest standard of quality in its work.
